top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop Despite Escalating U.S.-Iran Conflict
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, following the Tuesday release of the American Petroleum Institute oil stock report, which showed a build across crude and fuels. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.49 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $84.73 per barrel, both down sharply from a month ago when Brent crude was trading at over $100 per barrel, and WTI was at over $98. The American Petroleum Institute estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States rose by 5.3 million barrels in the week ending November…
